程序包 org.bukkit.scoreboard

接口 Objective

public interface Objective
代表单个计分板计分项, 可展示特定项目的分数. 此计分项只与getScoreboard()获取的计分板相关联.

原文： An objective on a scoreboard that can show scores specific to entries. This objective is only relevant to the display of the associated scoreboard.
